DOOR_ERR_FAR: You are too far from the door
DOOR_ERR_DENIED: You do not have the key
ADMIN_TAB_DOORS_DESC: Doors that lock, who may lock them and how they start.
ADMIN_C_DOOR_DESC: Pick the door type first, then the door in the world.
ADMIN_H_TYPE: Decides how many door objects you pick and how the door locks: swinging doors lock once they are shut, sliding doors and gates lock at once, garage doors and barriers keep the game's own movement.
ADMIN_H_DOOR: Pick the door in the world with the free camera (it is outlined when aimed at): its model and exact position are filled in. For a double door, one of the two leaves.
ADMIN_H_DOOR2: Only for a double door or a double sliding door: pick the other leaf the same way. Other door types ignore it.
ADMIN_C_ACCESS_DESC: Who may lock and unlock it, and how it starts.
ADMIN_H_LOCKED: The state after a server restart.
ADMIN_H_JOBS: Empty: anyone may lock and unlock. Otherwise members of these jobs.
ADMIN_H_DISTANCE: How close the player must be for the prompt. Gates and garage doors need more.
